the ex vivo effect of estrogen and progestins on VZV-specific immune responses in HIV-infected and HIV-uninfected subjects is similar to that of dexamethosone.
the effect of estrogen on CMI is more pronounced in HIV-infected individuals, whereas the effect on CMI of progesterone is more pronounced in uninfected subjects.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the concentrations of estradiol and progestin in the oral contraceptive pill are sufficient to down-regulate VZV cell-mediated immunity.
